links.outcome: AUROC of early warning score under missing inputs and forced imputation
links.effect: AUROC 0.918 with actual data fell to 0.883 with mean-based imputation and 0.827 with MICE; specificity at 80% sensitivity fell from 85.5% to 78.3%.
links.quote: When missing values were imputed using values randomly drawn from within one SD of the mean observed values for the corresponding non-event and event groups, the AUROC decreased to 0.883 (95% CI: 0.875–0.891) compared with 0.918 (95% CI: 0.912–0.924) under the model’s default normal-value imputation method (DeLong test, p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Differences in missing lab data between event and non-event patient groups and effect on model scores
links.effect: Non-event group had over 80% missing lactate and pH vs 7.37% and 6.91% in event group; forced imputation raised non-event average score from 7.7 to 10.6, increasing false positives.
links.quote: For instance, over 80% of the lactate and pH data were missing in the non-event group, compared to only 7.37% and 6.91%, respectively, in the event group.

links.outcome: Model AUROC with minimal inputs versus full inputs, with normal-value imputation
links.effect: With only vital signs and age, AUROC 0.896 (vs NEWS 0.797, MEWS 0.722); adding available clinical data raised it to 0.918 (p<0.001).
links.quote: Upon reintroducing the full set of originally collected clinical data, previously treated as missing, the VC-MAES performance improved significantly compared with the vital-signs-only scenario.

links.outcome: Discrimination of AI early warning score versus NEWS and MEWS on same data
links.effect: VC-MAES AUROC 0.896 vs NEWS 0.797 and MEWS 0.722; AUPRC 0.336 vs 0.125 (NEWS) and 0.079 (MEWS).
links.quote: These results indicate that VC-MAES outperformed both NEWS and MEWS in terms of both AUROC and AUPRC ( Figure 1 ).

links.outcome: Prospective silent-mode performance of the early warning model on live data
links.effect: Model generated real-time predictions undisclosed to clinicians; prospective AUROC 0.918 (full data) on 6039 encounters at an external site.
links.quote: The model generated predictions in real-time; however, these predictions were neither disclosed to healthcare providers nor incorporated into clinical decision-making processes.
